## Reading it

- A method beats the registry baseline only when the whole 95% interval of its MCC minus the baseline's lies above zero; a better point score inside an interval that crosses zero is a tie.
- The reference is Landsat-based and annual, so a loss Sentinel-2 sees in January can belong to the previous year in it; cells that lost cover in 2023 are left out of the stable set for that reason.
- Cells are 400 m: a clearing under 5% of a cell is left out rather than scored either way.
